newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bans illegal insurance sales - paper.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bans illegal insurance sales - paper.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of China's central bank has ordered domestic and foreign insurance companies and financial institutions to stop illegally selling insurance, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.

The bank said some insurance companies in the city illegally sold insurance but because they disguised the service they were offering it was difficult to uncover, the newspaper said but did not elaborate.
It said violators would be heavily punished, with fines of up to five times the value of any illegal contracts and the sacking of company officials.
